BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

3. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

   A. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

9. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket

14. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
